text: Ennerdale Avenue runs south from Eglinton Avenue West and is a high traffic route connecting residents to many nearby locations. Currently, Ennerdale Avenue benefits from traffic calming measures south to Dynevor Road. I have heard from residents that speeding is a major problem on the stretch between Hatherley Road and Dynevor Road, which lacks the same traffic calming measures. In response to these issues, a neighbourhood survey conducted by my office confirmed strong support for installing speed humps. These measures will help to reduce speeding and improve safety for all residents.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Authorized the installation of traffic calming (two speed humps) on Ennerdale Road, between Rochdale Avenue and Chudleigh Road, generally as shown in Attachment 2 to the letter (July 2, 2026) from Councillor Alejandra Bravo.
